reason: Creates the passive channel monitor V2 configuration and one-minute rollup tables, plus the indexes used by its bounded background aggregation and query paths.
risk: The migration creates normal indexes without CONCURRENTLY. If the target tables already exist and contain data from a partial or manual rollout, PostgreSQL can scan and briefly lock those tables while building the missing indexes.
mitigation: On the normal rollout path the tables are newly created and empty, all DDL is idempotent, and historical backfill is handled separately by a bounded worker. Keep the existing deployment health checks in place and investigate any pre-existing channel_monitor_v2 tables before retrying a partially applied migration.
